name: Nghe Tinh Soviet Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Xô viết Nghệ Tĩnh
kicker: The 1930–1931 rooms in the citadel yard
summary: Walk the rooms of the 1930–1931 movement in the citadel yard. A 2025 news page says more than 5,000 objects and photographs, and outdoor space next to the walls, nearly 2 km from the square. A street number was not on that page. Opening hours and a fee were not printed. This is not Bảo tàng Nghệ An on Đào Tấn.
